- `getScoreColor(score)` → Tailwind text color based on threshold
- `getScoreBgColor(score)` → Tailwind bg color

- `getScoreHex(score)` → Hex color for charts
- `getScoreLabel(score)` → "Critical" | "Poor" | "Below Average" | "Average" | "Good" | "Excellent"

### Severity & Effort Labels
- `getSeverityColor(severity)` → {bg, text, border, dot} color palette
- `getSeverityLabel(severity)` → Human-readable label
- `getEffortLabel(effort)` → "Quick Win" | "Moderate" | "Significant"
- `getEffortColor(effort)` → Tailwind color classes

### Weighted Scoring System
- **PAGE_TYPE_WEIGHTS**: Dynamic weights by page type (landing, product, etc.)
  - Example: Landing page CTA Effectiveness weighted 22%, Blog post only 12%
  - Shows CRO domain expertise in pillar importance
- `getPillarWeight(pillar, pageType)` → Returns weight 0-1
- `calculateWeightedScore(results, pageType)` → Calculates overall score
- **INDUSTRY_BENCHMARKS**: Industry average scores per pillar (48-72 range)
- `getIndustryBenchmark(pillar)` → Returns benchmark for comparison

### Percentile Ranking
- `getPercentileRank(score)` → 0-100 percentile (simulated distribution)
  - 90+ score = 97th percentile
  - Used for "you're better than X% of sites" messaging

### Formatting
- `formatScore(score)` → Rounds to integer
- `getTimeGreeting()` → "Good morning/afternoon/evening"
- `formatRelativeDate(dateStr)` → "Just now", "5m ago", "2d ago", etc.

### Architecture

### 8 Specialist AI Agents
| Agent | Role | Specialty |
|-------|------|-----------|
| CROBOT Prime | Orchestrator | Coordinates all agents |
| Clarity | Content Analyzer | Value prop & copy |
| Converge | CTA Specialist | Button placement & conversion |
| Shield | Trust Evaluator | Social proof & credibility |
| Prism | UX Auditor | Visual hierarchy & layout |
| Pocket | Mobile Expert | Responsive & tap targets |
| Blitz | Performance | Core Web Vitals & speed |
| Quill | Copy Writer | AI-rewritten alternatives |

### UI Components (6 new)
- **[AgentAvatar](src/components/agents/AgentAvatar.tsx)** — Gradient avatars with live status indicators
- **[AgentStatusBadge](src/components/agents/AgentStatusBadge.tsx)** — Animated status pills (thinking, working, reviewing, done)
- **[AgentCard](src/components/agents/AgentCard.tsx)** — Full + compact agent cards with stats
- **[TaskCard](src/components/agents/TaskCard.tsx)** — Task cards with progress, priority, agent avatars
- **[AgentMessage](src/components/agents/AgentMessage.tsx)** — Message bubbles with type-based styling (finding, suggestion, handoff, etc.)
- **[NewTaskDialog](src/components/agents/NewTaskDialog.tsx)** — Premium task creation flow with audit type selection

### Pages (2 new)
- **[/agents](src/pages/AgentHub.tsx)** — Command center with KPIs, live task board, agent roster, activity feed, task filters
- **[/agents/:taskId](src/pages/AgentWorkspace.tsx)** — Live workspace with real-time progressive message streaming, agent status panel, replay controls, typing indicators, and completion summary

- **Progressive message delivery** — Messages stream in with realistic timing based on type
- **Live status indicators** — Agents pulse while thinking/working, turn green on completion
- **Replay button** — Re-watch the entire agent collaboration from scratch
- **Agent handoffs** — Agents hand work to each other (Converge → Quill for copy rewrites)
- **Confidence scores** — Each finding shows AI confidence percentage
- **Impact estimates** — Every finding shows expected conversion lift
